two proteins, HDPB1 and HDBB2, which bind a unique cis-regulatory element in the promoter of the human HD gene, were isolated and identified as novel transcription factors.

the identification and characterization of novel transcription factors that bind to cis-acting element in the promoter of the HD gene.
the identification of novel nuclear shuttle proteins and the cis-element for the HD gene expression in the human neuronal cell line.

we identified two novel nuclear shuttling transcription factors, HDBP 1 and 2, which are essential for the expression of the HD gene in neuronal cells.

the transcriptional regulation of the HD gene in neurons is controlled by the nuclear export of HDBP1 or HDBP2.

the expression of HD gene in neuronal cells is tightly regulated by a specific transcription factor(s) and that the expression of this factor(s) may be a potential target for the therapy of HD.
